subject: Wake time after sleep onset (in minutes)

messages.author: 496348653760ec80
messages.subject: Wake time after sleep onset (in minutes)
parts:
Hello,

Does the following variables represent what do we know as wake time after sleep onset (waso)? If not, which variable should I take as waso?

dur_nightwak_and_IN30_min

and these are also waso but with different thresholds?

dur_nightwak_LIG30_100_min
dur_nightwak_MOD100_400_min
dur_nightwak_VIG400_min


I have been trying to find info regarding these above mentioned variables you get with part5 output but it is still not clear to me.

Many thanks,
Best,
Alba Cabré

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Wake time after sleep onset (in minutes)
parts:
Yes, that is correct. If you add them up it will give you an estimate of WASO.
In a future release of GGIR we may add WASO as an explicit variable.

Best, Vincent
